notes: One run per adapterstest.RunJSONBidderTest call in adapters/*/*_test.go.
fixture_root is walked like test_json.go: a .json file runs when its parent directory is named amp, exemplary, supplemental, video or videosupplemental.
adapter/server are the config.Adapter/config.Server literals passed to Builder, every field present (""/0 when unset).
setup lists statements around construction that change state; hooks (from go_fixture_hooks.json) give their effect in a fixed vocabulary, and global_hooks apply to every run.
